name: radio-group
title: Radio Group
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A set of mutually-exclusive radio options. Pair each RadioGroupItem with an external Label via id/htmlFor — its own children slot is for a custom indicator, not label text. `RadioCard` is a choice card: the whole card is the radio, its children are the content (an `IconTile`, `FieldContent` with `FieldTitle` and `FieldDescription`) and a round indicator sits at the end; selected cards take a `primary` tint, hovered ones `accent`. Lay several out with a `className` grid on the group.
